blockers.summary: The only quantitative evidence that the two reagents named for synthesis clear the energy-based off-target screen is quoted as a bare point value, with none of the one-directional bias its producing artifact records - while every other bound in the paper carries its direction explicitly.

New guard requires the direction and forbids a merged range, deriving the requirement from that field.

blockers.summary: The new Interpretation sentence's supporting universal is false against the paper's own precursor-arm screen: a parent pairs 14 contiguous base pairs, not 13. The claim audit stated it scoped ('the parent SCREEN never produces a run longer than 13 bp'); the prose dropped the scope and made it a statement about parents.
blockers.status: fixed in this round: scoped to "no design's own parent ... in either compartment". Re-derived independently: the mature arm's maximum own-parent run is 13 and the precursor arm's is also 13; the 14-base-pair run the seat cites is TCF12 against a TFG::NR4A3 design, so it is a parent GENE of the panel and not that design's parent. Both readings of "parent" are defensible English and only one is what the paragraph is about, so the prose now says which. The guard was rewritten to derive the bound from BOTH screens.

Separately, exactly two registers of the EWSR1 e13->NR4A3 e2 seam (CAGTGGGCTCTCCACG, GCAGTGGGCTCTCCAC) carry a hybridisable, gap-fully-paired 2-mismatch hit in wild-type NR4A3 pre-mRNA while the named reagent carries none — matching 'it excludes two registers ... while clearing that reagent'.

p1s.status: CLOSED in this round: test_the_three_geometries_are_reported_as_a_rate_and_not_a_bare_count binds the three counts, the three panel sizes, the three rates and the convergence at 5-10-5, all derived from the artifact.

p1s.summary: 'the same ten shared donor bases that let one oligonucleotide span the EWSR1, TAF15 and FUS breakpoints at once' is correct at the pin and unbound. Recomputed from the atlas's junction contexts: EWSR1 e12 donor tail ...AATGGTTTGATG, TAF15 e11 and FUS e10 ...ACTGGTTTGATG — the shared 3' donor suffix is TGGTTTGATG, exactly 10 nt; the reagent's target window takes 8 donor bases, so it spans all three. Consistently, GGGCATATCATCAAAC appears in the panel at three junctions.
